reference_materials: Manufacturer gallery images 356103_1 and 356103_2 compared against the final front and rear captures; cached source photographs are referenced, not redistributed.

Ten final browser captures are covered: seven changed views were inspected after the case/clip correction; the hook front/top and scale top captures are byte-identical to the previously inspected versions.
findings: Three independent inspection shapes preserve one 5.30 m inferred continuous strip. The 5 m state is a length reference; its small casing in the whole-object view is expected.
Analytic brake-crown arcs replace a filleted spline whose CAD tessellation contained holes. Shared case partition masks eliminate exported nonmanifold material slivers.
Graduation surfaces now use the same transverse facets as the blade. Previously buried centimetre numbers are visible in the final top and hook captures.

Body, clip, blade and three-rivet rubber-backed hook are individually inspectable. All 100 geometry checks and 22 browser checks pass, without conferring appearance acceptance or physical operation qualification.

The revised clip has a broad slotted lower paddle, curved upper returns, a root-connected release tongue and a true hole, matching visible topology in the rear manufacturer photograph. Elastic function is not claimed.
The front brake axle is now enclosed in blind seats, housing screw heads sit in actual counterbores, and three shallow lower-case relief grooves replace the previous blank surface.
A single retracted tool is staged on the actual laboratory service worktop. Its complete bounds, actual base contacts and surrounding solid geometry pass the composition checks.
open_appearance_gaps: Fine molded surface texture and exact local contours remain photo-based approximations; no manufacturer CAD or calibrated surface measurements are available in the inspected sources.
geometry_limits: No official CAD or exact local measurements. Source 87 × 30 × 78 mm body dimensions exclude clip protrusions.
Internal brake transmission, return spring/reel, elastic clip, the 100 mm internal-measurement datum and reverse CC markings remain unresolved.
No simulated retraction, calibrated hook lost motion, sag, measurement, grasp or robot operation. Inspection shapes are not extra inventory.
